scope: First cold result for each notice. For 1/2/10/16 use the separate transport run invoking actual Java backend excerpts. Other 16 model-input payloads were byte-for-byte equivalent before/after backend excerpt application. Diagnostic reruns excluded. Reference is assistant reviewed, not independent human validated. Counts are document-family inclusion before display truncation, NOT overall semantic accuracy.

semantic_findings.description: 사업계획서 is required by the main submission table, absent from generated submission checklist.
외주용역 활용계획서 appears in the plan instructions. Not an automatic false positive merely because outside the initial main-table reference; conditional on outsourcing, while the output marks MANDATORY.
협정서 / LOI / all-institution-signed English plan alternative is absent. The plain English-plan row does not include the required all-institution signature qualification.
기업부설연구소 인정서 has an added '또는 면제 사유 문서' alternative absent from the cited submission row.
국문연구개발계획서 and 신청자격 적정성 확인서 are required in the source, but the generated rows say CONDITIONAL / 적용 대상 확인 필요.
참여의사 확인서 and 정보동의·청렴보안서약서 recur under MANDATORY and CONDITIONAL variants.
중소(중견)기업 확인서 is mandatory in source row 2, but report labels it 필요시 제출, which belongs to the subsequent additional-evidence category.
Separate diagnostic call extracted 사업계획서 and 결산재무제표; the latter was removed because a synthesized semicolon-separated condition failed verbatim substring matching.
Separate diagnostic returned two grouped rows, both rejected. Quotes omitted the submission-table heading/cue; second condition was absent from its quote. Not added to the primary measurement.

Forced component experiment (business gate bypassed, no app persistence) recovered all 5 reference application families, but also emitted a duplicate financial statement and a mandatory 직무기술서 및 멘토링 운영계획서 row without explicit document-submission support in its cited evaluation criteria. This is not 100% overall accuracy.
